I rent this small maize plot, so I cannot spend too much, but here in Mbeya the rains are good and maize gives us food and a little to sell. I will buy a small bag of urea to top-dress, because without fertilizer the yield is poor on this tired soil, but I cannot afford much. I will use improved seed from the agrodealer in town — the hybrid does better than the seed I save, especially with the armyworm problem we have now, so I will also buy a little pesticide when I see the worms in the funnels. My husband and children help me, but during weeding I usually call one or two neighbors for a few days and pay them.
